hook.en: The one-eyed chief of the gods, who gave an eye for wisdom and hung nine nights on a tree to win the runes.

value.en: Husband of Frigg; father of Þórr, whose mother is Jörð, the Earth
Ásgarðr; from his high seat Hliðskjálf he sees the whole world
The ravens Huginn and Muninn, who bring him the news of the world every day
His wisdom: an eye left as pledge at Mímir's well; the runes won on the windy tree
Swallowed by the wolf Fenrir at Ragnarök; his son Víðarr avenges him

why.en: Gangleri's first question: the highest god and his twelve names
Óðinn tells how he hung on the tree and took up the runes

hook.en: The strongest of the gods, who drives a goat chariot and defends gods and men with his hammer Mjöllnir.

value.en: Þrúðvangar, with the hall Bilskirnir, the greatest of all houses
The hammer Mjöllnir, the belt of strength and the iron gloves; a chariot drawn by two he-goats
His journeys against the giants: Útgarða-Loki, Hrungnir, Þrymr
At Ragnarök he kills the Miðgarðsormr, walks nine paces and falls dead from its venom

why.en: his goats, his hammer, his belt and gloves
the morning his hammer is gone
the duel with the giant Hrungnir
